propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs hung at 99% progress for 1.7–4.3 hours until manual cancellation, caused by stale Gerrit patchsets omitting blob-prefetch fix 96a0d5c3f and triggering per-blob lazy-fetch on shallow clones.

The reusable workflow _build-and-test.yml test job lacked a timeout-minutes configuration, allowing GitHub's 360-minute default to mask the underlying blob-fetching defect and require manual clearing instead of automatic failure.

FakeJiraClient.search_issues in test_jira_dc_transport.py ignored startAt/maxResults pagination parameters, causing test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract to infinite-loop on 1129 PS3, timeout, and fail to detect that the underlying _paged_search implementation was correct.

Adding jobs.test.timeout-minutes: 60 to _build-and-test.yml jobs.test bounds the default suite to a reasonable execution window, eliminating dependence on manual clearing and catching future regressions.

Fixing FakeJiraClient.search_issues to slice results by startAt/maxResults offset resolved the pagination contract test infinite loop while preserving production pager logic and all existing assertions.
